recentItems.title: Build a Butterfly House with Elmo, Abby, and Grover! 🦋  | Sesame Street & LEGO Little Ones
recentItems.description:

Use your creativity to build your own pretend butterfly house at http://www.LEGO.com/buildthechangewithsesame. This activity is part of the LEGO Group’s Build the Change social impact program, which encourages children to use creativity to tackle real-world challenges.
